title: The sub-agent ledger's lock on windows-latest: an exclusive create that meets a lock file being removed raises PermissionError and reaches the caller unhandled; trace the cause, show it on Windows and repair the acquire path without skipping tests, weakening checks or adding retries for green (DB-157; D-090-R093/R094)
objective: Trace and repair the cause of the Windows failure recorded as DB-157, under /deficit-convergence. On 2026-10-06 the supervisor-bridge job on windows-latest failed once (tools/test_agent_supervisor_mrl_subagent_contract.py::TestLedger::test_parallel_requests_never_exceed_limits: two requests admitted, five refused, and the eighth thread died with PermissionError [Errno 13] raised by os.open(lock, O_CREAT | O_EXCL | O_WRONLY) in `_exclusive()` of tools/agent_supervisor/mrl_subagent_contract.py); the push run on the same head passed the same job. `_exclusive()` retries only on FileExistsError, so on Windows an error of another kind at the exclusive create reaches the caller as an unhandled exception instead of a retry or the module's own fail-closed refusal. The working hypothesis, to be PROVED OR RULED OUT on windows-latest and never assumed: when one thread is removing the lock file at the instant another creates it, Windows reports the pending delete as access denied. The slot lock in review_slots.py already treats exactly this case as 'busy' (the earlier repair); this module does not. Make ONE bounded change to the acquire path of `_exclusive()` so that the proven transient Windows case is retried within the lock's own timeout and ends, if it never clears, in the module's own fail-closed refusal; an error that is not the proven transient case stays loud. No test is skipped, weakened or retried to obtain a green run, and the ledger's safety assertions (never more than the allowed concurrent and total sub-agents) are preserved.
business_reason: Owner authorization D-090-R093 (a bounded repair of the recurring Windows supervisor-bridge failures in a separate pull request: find out whether the cause is test timing or a real defect, and fix the cause) and prohibition R094 (preserve the safety and concurrency assertions; no skipped test, weakened check or retry merely for green CI). QUALIFYING EVIDENCE under the supervisor freeze (.claude/rules/supervisor-freeze.md, AD-093): a reproduced defect - run 37519342596, job 112460379795, frozen under project-control/reports/M0-T186-ci-evidence/. Until it is repaired any run can fail this job at random, and a pull request merges only on a fully green run. Discovery row DB-157. A change under tools/agent_supervisor/** carries the recertification cost recorded for the earlier repair (M0-T184): a recorded cost, not a bar.
inputs: tools/agent_supervisor/review_slots.py `_SlotLock.acquire` and its tests in tools/test_agent_supervisor_review_slots.py (how the earlier repair treats the Windows pending-delete case as busy, and how it is tested) - READ ONLY

acceptance_scenarios.expected: the complete path from the eight threads to the one unhandled exception is traced, and each candidate is PROVED or RULED OUT with the evidence that decides it: (a) the exclusive create meeting a lock file whose removal by another thread is pending (Windows reports access denied); (b) another process holding the file open (antivirus, indexer); (c) a fault of the test itself (shared tmp_path, thread start order); (d) test timing. The record says why the count was 2 admitted and 5 refused with one thread lost, and whether any request was admitted beyond the limits (it must not have been)

the deciding Windows behaviour is DEMONSTRATED on windows-latest, never assumed from Linux or from memory of the Windows API: a deterministic test that is RED on a ci-exp/M0-T186-* branch before the repair (orchestrator-pushed from a producer-prepared commit holding the tests only), with its run and job ids in the record; or, if no deterministic reproduction is possible, the record says so plainly and what evidence stands in its place

ONE bounded change to the acquire loop: the proven transient Windows case is treated as 'lock busy' and retried with the loop's own sleep until the lock's own deadline; when it never clears, the caller gets the module's own fail-closed refusal (the same kind as a held lock past the timeout), never an unhandled exception and never an admission; an OSError that is not the proven transient case is NOT swallowed (on POSIX a PermissionError at the create stays loud); no unbounded loop; the release path and every other function are unchanged unless S2 proves they are part of the cause

new deterministic tests, runnable on any host: (i) the transient case - the create fails N times with the Windows error and then succeeds -> the request is served and the limits hold; (ii) the never-clears case -> bounded, fail-closed, the module's typed refusal, no admission; (iii) an error that is not the transient case -> not swallowed; (iv) a Windows-only test of the platform fact itself, skipped elsewhere with skipUnless. MUTATION PROOF in the report: with the repair reverted to the literal pre-fix code, (i) and (ii) fail

additions only: no test deleted, skipped (except S5 iv), xfail-marked or renamed; no assertion loosened - test_parallel_requests_never_exceed_limits keeps 'exactly 2 allowed and 6 refused' and its limits; no retry or rerun of a TEST, no rerun plugin, no .github/** change, no timeout raised to hide the failure
